TOOLING BURST T4m — align the tests to the lap-3 burst_v2 (Run C-5; conductor R-C5-33: the effect is ACCEPTED as built by T4l; six tests now encode superseded or mis-stated expectations). task_id "T4m". No production behaviour changes.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 row T4h including its lap-2, lap-3 and "Lap-3 clause CORRECTED" text — the corrected clause is the contract the tests must encode.
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (the six reds named below), export/effect_kit.py + export/godot_import.py (read only — the current lap-3 behaviour is the truth the tests describe), runs/C-5/t3/T4l/acceptance.json (your lap-3 numbers).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib only; Godot for the headless fixtures the tests already use.

FIX exactly these six reds (outside-sandbox suite, 2026-09-16) so they encode the CORRECTED clause and the lap-3 build; do not weaken any assertion that still describes current behaviour, and do not touch production code:
- test_effect_kit.BurnBackMaterialTests.test_real_schedule_compactness_and_hold_denominator → compactness ≥ 0.9 from erosion start through residue ENTRY only (ember frames exempt); hold-peak denominator as is.
- test_effect_kit.BurnBackResidueHoldTests.test_literal_fraction_held_for_every_residue_age → residue fraction in [0.15, 0.25] at residue ENTRY; thereafter monotone non-increasing to release (the ember dissolve).
- test_effect_kit.PieceLap2ValidationTests.test_stretch_seed_bounds_and_whole_body_distance and test_effect_kit.PieceStretchPhaseTests.test_stretch_seed_bounds_and_whole_body_distance → stretch bounds 2.0–2.5 along, 0.85 across; whole-body distance sampling and root drift ≤ 0.5 × core radius as built.
- test_godot_import.PieceStretchImportTests.test_axes_whole_field_root_residue_clock_and_grey → the lap-3 emission (outside-in erosion flag, residue-only dissolve, screen_px, moderated stretch), clock and grey substitution as built.
- test_vfx_picker.PieceLap2ExportTests.test_v2_emits_drift_stretch_… (the remaining lap-2 export expectation) → lap-3 values.
Then run the FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected: all green except the five standing reds (test_f04_outside_at_least_three; three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid) plus your sandbox's headless-Godot env reds — name every red. Write runs/C-5/t3/T4m/acceptance.json with the before/after red lists.

DO NOT touch: anything except the three named test files; no production code; nothing under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4m/. Do not run git. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4m"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
